items: 2-in-1 Android Tablet - Our versatile tablet effortlessly transforms from a tablet to a portable laptop with the included mouse and keyboard, you can use it easily for productivity while on the move or switch to tablet mode to enjoy entertainment.

Android 15 Tablet with GMS Certification - The tablet is powered by the latest Android 15 operating system. It offers an easy-to-use interface and access to a wide range of apps, games and services through Google Play Store. You can keep up with the latest features and experience a seamless and simple user experience.

10.1 Inch HD Screen - Immerse yourself in breathtaking visuals on the expansive 10.1 inch high definition IPS display. Featuring a resolution of 1280*800, every image and video bursts with vibrant hues and pristine clarity.
12GB RAM & 64GB ROM - Allow you to multitask and store important data, pictures and videos,you can even add a 1TB Micro SD card for more storage.

Dual Cameras and more - This android tablet features a 2MP front camera and an 8MP rear camera, supporting 2.4GHz WiFi / WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0. It has a built-in 6000mAh lithium battery for reliable all-day performance.
